properties.title: Freebuff

overview_description.description: Freebuff provides AI coding agents and software development tools through terminal, desktop, web, cloud, and chat interfaces. Its CLI and Desktop products edit codebases from natural-language instructions, while Freebuff Web generates, previews, and deploys full-stack applications from prompts. Freebuff Cloud connects GitHub repositories to cloud sandboxes with live previews, and Freebuff Chat provides an AI question-and-answer service. The company also offers custom deployments for engineering organizations, including infrastructure-specific hosting, policy controls, retention settings, and integrations with internal tools.

about_short_description.short_description: Freebuff provides AI coding agents and app-building tools across terminal, desktop, web, cloud, and chat.

product.name: Freebuff CLI
product.description: A terminal-based coding agent that edits and works with software projects from natural-language instructions.

product.name: Freebuff Desktop
product.description: A desktop application that runs coding agents in separate workspaces on a user's computer.

product.name: Freebuff Web
product.description: A web-based app builder that creates, previews, and deploys full-stack applications from natural-language prompts.

product.name: Freebuff Cloud
product.description: A cloud workspace that runs GitHub repositories in sandboxes and provides live application previews.

product.name: Freebuff Chat
product.description: An AI chat service that researches questions and generates responses for users.

product.name: Freebuff Enterprise
product.description: Enterprise coding-agent deployments with custom infrastructure, governance, retention, and integration options.
